items.title: Racer Teens
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Hit the track in your fabulous racing suit, shift into gear and overtake them all becoming the ultimate champion! Show your friends that you are speed with these sleek and cool skins!

- 8 skins
- By Rareloot

items.title: One Block Skyblock
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Discover a hardcore skyblock challenge! Try to beat the game only by mining a single block floating in the middle of nowhere!
Will you be experienced enough?

- An infinitely regenerating block, providing all the resources you need!
- 6 custom floating islands, with dungeons and hidden treasures!
- Tons of fun alone or with your friends!
- By Pixelusion

items.title: Samurai vs Ninja
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Be swift and silent like a ninja or strong and fearless like a samurai. Which path will you choose?

- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from JPlaysPE.

items.title: Tactical Robots
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Discover a new way to protect and defend with Tactical Robots skins. Battle and role-play with friends as indestructible cyber soldiers. Fulfill heroic missions as a rescue bot saving the day. Scout the enemy as a reconnaissance or tactical drone bot. Deactivate weapons as a bomb squad bot or dive deep and help your squad from under the sea.

+ 8 power machine HD skins

items.title: PvP Teens
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Nothing could be more fun than player vs. player! Choose from plenty of awesome teen skins to role-play as a pro in any fight. Perfect for survival games, in the battle arena, and on all servers. Gear up for combat in these super skins and go for the win!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Cute Gamers
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Look completely cute AND be the best gamer in town. Select from lots of sweet skin styles that show off how adorable you are. In headset and mic, role-play and win all the tournaments, as you distract the other players with maximum cuteness!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Future Robots
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Gear up for the future! There are robots everywhere! Choose from 12 different options and gear up as magnificent tech machines. Role-play as an adorable android or super cute cyborg. Become the most colorful bot around as you shock the future!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Pajama Dreams
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Sweet dreams are here! Cuddle up in the cutest pajamas and sleep like a baby. Choose from a bunch of adorably comfortable skins and take an afternoon nap. Wake up and role-play in sweet slippers and cozy PJs. Now that you’re awake, there’s no time for snoozing.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Lucky Block Heads
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Good or bad? Try your luck and see! Spread fortune or failure when you role-play in any of these 12 different skins. Will you cause your friends to be down on their luck or give them lucky breaks? No question about it, with these blocks on your shoulders, you’re either in or out of luck!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Kimono Fashion
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Join the latest fashion trend! Wrap yourself in formal robes like from ancient Japan and role-play in some serious style. With lots of different looks to choose from, these colorful kimonos with pretty patterns are traditional and fabulous. Tie it up with a sash or belt and show your respect for the past.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Dogs
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Hey! Look at those cuties! They're good boys! All they're waiting for is an owner to pick them up and have some fun! Get one of these puppies available in the Dogs skin pack!

+ 13 skins

items.title: Arctic Bunker
items.creator: Vertexcubed
items.description:
The world has ended. Quick, jump in this massive city-sized bunker and rebuild humanity with advanced farms and contraptions! Then upgrade your bunker and explore the frozen world around it! 
+ Custom 3D Models 
+ 50 different AREAS to explore 
+ Discover SECRET rooms 
+ Survive against all odds 

! Play solo or roleplay with your squad

items.title: Trendy Demons
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
The famously fashionable trendy demons are finally among us! Why let your dreams be dreams, go join them and have fun in gamemodes like skyblock and lucky block! Express your inner demon and be the best!

- 12 demon skins
- By inPixel

items.title: Epic Millionaire Mansions
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Live like a millionaire in this world with different mansions to pick from, one even has a lighthouse! Hop into your very own personal cruise ship and live a life in luxury and riches!

- 3 islands with mansions
- By inPixel

items.title: Super Pets
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
These heroes have been training every day to fight evil. Suit up and save the day by becoming a super pet!

- 12 adorable animal skins
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from LeadPro

items.title: Space Agents
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Blast off! With 10 unique designs, Space Agents has a skin for everyone! Sneak around space in these crazy cool skins!

- 10 Space-themed skins
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from 5 Frame Studios.

items.title: Deep Dark Sea
items.creator: House of How
items.description: Below the light, where cold salt water suffocates all that dare approach, there are those that not only survive, but thrive. Eels which stalk their prey, jelly fish which engulf all that come near, and anglers which tempt with bioluminescent bait. Join the kingdom of darkness, earn the respect of the princess of divers with these 11 phantasmal skins.

items.title: Crazy House Party
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Woohoo, you are invited to the craziest house party across the whole globe!

+ 14 teens, ready to party all night and enjoy the coolest house music!
+ 1 FREE skin included!

* By Senior Studios & Blackstone Studios!

items.title: Wacky Samurais HD
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Join the samurai team and become one of the greatest warriors ever seen!

+ 7 HD samurais, bringing the ultimate combat technique back to life!

* By Senior Studios & Blackstone Studios!

items.title: Spacebot
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Colorful robots from all over the galaxy have arrived! Choose your favorite, enjoy playing, and exploring.

- 6 HD space-themed robots skins included!
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from Noel Design.

items.title: MONSTERS
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Become a scary monster with these freaky creatures and spook your friends.

by: Pickaxe Studios

items.title: Space Suits
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
These space explorers are journeying into the unknown! Luckily, they have their new and improved space suits equipped! With so many skins to choose from, you can find the perfect astronaut skin to suit you!

- 9 different skins to choose from!

items.title: Royal Mobs
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
It's a well known fact that any queen or king needs a crown, but so do these royal mobs! Rule your kingdom with a skin that suits your style!

With 8 skins, including the following:
- Creeper
- Enderman
- Pig
- Zombie
- Skeleton
- Slime
- Spider
- Piglin

items.title: PETS: Shop
items.creator: HorizonBlocks
items.description:
Be the proud owner of your most loved pets. Take care of your pet by feeding, playing or going for a walk with your pet through your beautiful city. Master one of several parkours at the dog school. 

+ NEW PETS: Cats, dogs, hamsters, snakes, pugs, birds, turtles, geckos, spiders, poodles (different color variants)
+ OWN MUSIC
+ 5 SKINS (2 free) 
+ NEW VEHICLES, TOYS, FOOD
